entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hong Bang, a notable figure in the history of Vietnam, associated with Prehistoric Vietnam and Dong Son (1000 BCE–207 BCE). Preceded by Early Settlement and Hoabinhian Culture. Their legacy influenced Duong Vuong founds the Au Lac state and builds the Co Loa citadel and Dong Son bronze drums — masterpieces of Southeast Asian metallurgy — created.
